hacking.help: Find the password in the memory dump. Click a word to try it, or type it. Typing part of a word is fine. Disconnect gives up before the trace completes.
hacking._classes: What each class of computer is like. The keys are the difficulty words a scene or the game master uses: length is the password's, words the size of the dump, tries how many wrong tries the trace allows before training adds its own, decoys how many words look nearly right, layers how many passwords stand between you and the inside, and mark whether a completed trace leaves a fact on the record.
hacking._training: What training adds, from untrained to master: wrong tries the trace allows on top of the class's, free probes, and how many wrong words a probe clears.
hacking._hints: What the advisor says, by training level. Each level's lines come after the ones below it. Blanks: {count} words still possible, {possible} a line listing them, {best} the word to try next, {left} wrong tries left, {trace} the trace in percent, {probes} free probes, {clears} words a probe clears, {layer}, {layers}, {layerName}, {className}.

0: The server says how many letters of your word are right, and in the right place. Start with a word that shares letters with many others.
Reading a file can cost a try: the useful ones are watched.
1: {count} of the words still fit everything the server has said.
2: notes.txt and passwd.bak are safe for you to open: one gives the first letter, the other retires two wrong words.
3: Try {best} next. Whatever the answer is, its likeness rules out the most.
A probe clears {clears} wrong words, and you have {probes} free.
4: {left} wrong tries left before the trace completes.

results.successLine: The exploit runs clean. The system's yours, for now.
results.failureLine: The exploit bounces. Somewhere, a log entry has your name on it.

noteLines: "Reminder to self: the new password starts with {letter}. Change it before the audit."
"Told the night shift it begins with {letter}. Do NOT write it down." Someone wrote that down.
"Password hint, as if I'd forget: first letter {letter}."
motd: Welcome. All sessions are monitored. Have a safe and productive shift.
NOTICE: the coffee machine on deck 4 is not a network device. Stop trying to log in to it.
Reminder: refugee manifests are confidential. Sharing them is a Ministry offense.
This node hasn't been patched since the Fall. Nobody's left who knows how.
Scheduled maintenance has been cancelled due to the end of civilization.

engineering.opening: You pop the panel. Half the relays are dead, and whoever wired this should be ashamed.
engineering.help: Click a relay to flip it. It also flips the ones wired to it. Get every relay live.

results.successLine: It catches, it hums, and it holds.
results.failureLine: Something pops behind the panel, and the smell isn't good.

science.opening: You feed the readings in. There's a pattern in there, if you can find its parts.
science.help: Click the symbols to build an attempt. # means exact, o means right but in the wrong place.

results.successLine: The numbers line up, and now they mean something.
results.failureLine: The data's noise, or you've read it wrong, and you can't tell which.

medicine.opening: The monitor comes up. Everything's moving the wrong way, and everyone's looking at you.
medicine.help: Each turn, choose a treatment. Keep the numbers inside the = marks.

results.successLine: The numbers settle. The room starts breathing again.
results.failureLine: It isn't working, and it's going to need something you don't have.

actions.name: Oxygen
actions.line: the color comes back a little.

actions.name: Watch and wait
actions.line: sometimes the best thing is to do nothing.

actions.name: Careful dosing
actions.line: a little of each, and it's exactly right.

events.text: The patient seizes on the table.
Blood pressure falls away.
A lung isn't taking air.
The heart stumbles.
A hidden bleed opens up.
The fever spikes.
The shock's wearing off, and the body's fighting back.
Breathing goes shallow.

lore.opening: You lay the fragments side by side. The glyphs repeat, and that has to mean something.
lore.help: Click the glyphs to build a reading. # means exact, o means right but in the wrong place.

results.successLine: The meaning surfaces all at once, like a shape under water.
results.failureLine: You can read the words. You just can't trust what you think they mean.

piloting.opening: You take the stick. Proximity alarms start up before you've even finished your first turn.
piloting.help: Go left, straight or right, one move at a time. The arrow keys work too.
piloting.hitLine: Something big scrapes down the hull!
piloting.wreckLine: Alarms everywhere. She can't take any more of this.

results.successLine: You bring her through, and someone behind you lets out a very long breath.
results.failureLine: The ship goes where it wants to, and you find out where along with everyone else.

athletics.opening: You're already moving. There's a lot in the way.
athletics.help: Go left, straight or right, one move at a time. The arrow keys work too.
athletics.hitLine: You clip it hard, and nearly go down.
athletics.wreckLine: Your legs are done, and so is your lead.

results.successLine: You get there with your lungs on fire and nothing broken.
results.failureLine: Your body has opinions about this, and they win.

void_ops.opening: The airlock opens on nothing at all. Your suit's display wakes up and starts counting.
void_ops.help: Move across the hull one step at a time, and keep out of the path of the debris. Nothing moves until you do.
void_ops.seenLine: Debris clips your suit, and the alarm starts chirping.
void_ops.caughtLine: Your tether's gone, and the hull's sliding away. You make one desperate jump.
void_ops.lateLine: Your air's nearly gone. You have to go now.

results.successLine: The pressure comes up, and you can hear yourself breathing again.
results.failureLine: You make it back in, but not the way you planned, and not in one piece of good news.

stealth.opening: You wait for the footsteps to pass. Then you count them, and start working it out.
stealth.help: Move one step at a time, and stay out of anyone's line of sight. Nothing moves until you do.
stealth.seenLine: A head turns. Did they see you?
stealth.caughtLine: "Hey! You there!" So much for that.
stealth.lateLine: Time's up. You've got to move, ready or not.

results.successLine: You're through, and nobody will ever know you were there.
results.failureLine: Someone's shouting now, and they're shouting about you.

gunnery.opening: The targeting solution keeps slipping. It's jinking, and it knows what it's doing.
gunnery.help: Click the square where the target will be when your shot gets there.
gunnery.hitLine: Direct hit! Something comes off it.
gunnery.missLine: Your shot goes on into the dark.

results.successLine: The grid lights up, and the bridge goes quiet in a good way.
results.failureLine: They're still coming, and now they know what your guns can do.

firearms.opening: You bring the weapon up, and breathe out. It's moving. Aim where it's going to be.
firearms.help: Click the square where your target will be when the shot gets there.
firearms.nearLine: It chips the wall right by them.

results.successLine: One clean shot, exactly where it needed to go.
results.failureLine: The noise is all anyone remembers, and it told everyone where you are.

melee.opening: You close the distance, and you can see their weight shift.
melee.help: Choose your move each exchange. What you can see of their stance might be a feint.

moves.name: Thrust
moves.tell: Their guard's dropping. It looks like they're about to thrust.

moves.name: Parry
moves.tell: They're coiled and waiting. It looks like they'll parry.

moves.name: Feint
moves.tell: There's something sly in their footwork. It looks like a feint.

winLines: They read it wrong, and pay for it.
A clean hit, and they back off.
tieLines: Steel on steel, and neither of you gains a thing.
You're both still standing, both still breathing hard.

results.successLine: You've got the opening you needed.
results.failureLine: They're better than you thought, or you're more tired.

tactics.opening: You pull up what you know about their positions, and what you know is less than you'd like.
tactics.help: Choose your orders each round. The intel might be wrong, so watch for their habits.

moves.name: Advance
moves.tell: Scouts report them massing to come straight at you.

moves.name: Hold the line
moves.tell: They're fortifying. It looks like they'll hold.

moves.name: Flank
moves.tell: Movement on the far side. It looks like they're going around.

winLines: You catch them out of position, and they know it.
loseLines: That cost you, and you can see it on the board.
tieLines: The two sides grind against each other, and nothing changes.

results.successLine: The pieces fall where you said they would.
results.failureLine: It's a good plan for the battle you thought you were in.

navigation.opening: You pull the chart up. There are a hundred ways across, and most of them end badly.
navigation.help: Click your next stop. Each one adds drift, and you can only shift one row at a time.
navigation.hazardLine: Gravity shear! That wasn't on the chart. +3 drift.

results.successLine: The numbers close, and it's a beautiful line.
results.failureLine: It'll get you somewhere. You're just not certain where.

persuasion.opening: They've folded their arms, but they haven't left. That's something.
persuasion.help: Choose how you come at this. See how they react, and don't say the same thing twice if you can help it.
persuasion.wonLine: They let out a long breath. They're with you.
persuasion.lostLine: They hold up a hand. They've heard enough.

approaches.name: Lay out the facts
approaches.line: Here's what we know, and here's what follows from it.

approaches.name: Appeal to duty
approaches.line: You know your duty. You've always known it.

approaches.name: Talk about who gets hurt
approaches.line: There are real people on the end of this decision.

approaches.name: Point to the danger
approaches.line: If we don't act, it won't wait for us to feel ready.

approaches.name: Say what's in it for them
approaches.line: Forget me. Think about what you stand to gain.

approaches.name: Talk about what we owe each other
approaches.line: We only got this far because people carried each other.

approaches.name: Leave the choice with them
approaches.line: I won't tell you what to do. It's your call, and it always was.

approaches.name: Trust in something larger
approaches.line: You've felt it too, that this is bigger than any of us.

approaches.name: Show them what could be
approaches.line: We don't have to stay what we've been.

approaches.name: Admit what you don't know
approaches.line: I'll be honest. I'm scared too, and I don't have all of it.

strong: That lands. You see it land.
They go still, and then they nod slowly.
Something in their face opens up.
good: They tilt their head. They're listening now.
It's not agreement, but it's closer.
flat: They wait for you to say something else.
bad: Their jaw sets. Wrong thing to say.
You've just lost ground, and you know it.

results.successLine: You can see it in their shoulders before they say a word.
results.failureLine: They've made up their mind, and it isn't your way.

leadership.opening: They're all looking at you. Nobody's said anything yet, and that's the worst part.
leadership.help: Choose how you speak to them. A crew knows when you're faking it, so read them as you go.
leadership.wonLine: Somebody at the back starts moving. Then they all do.
leadership.lostLine: The murmuring starts, and it doesn't stop.

approaches.name: Tell it straight
approaches.line: Here's how bad it is. I won't dress it up.

approaches.name: Give the order
approaches.line: This is what's happening. Move.

approaches.name: Share the danger
approaches.line: I'm going first. Anyone with me?

approaches.name: Honor the dead
approaches.line: Everyone we've lost got us to this room. We owe them the next step.

approaches.name: Shame them
approaches.line: Is this who you are? Because the people out there are counting on better.

approaches.name: Promise them something
approaches.line: Do this, and you've got my word on what comes after.

approaches.name: Let them decide
approaches.line: I won't order you into this. Who's in?

approaches.name: See their fear
approaches.line: I know you're tired. I know what I'm asking.

strong: You can feel the room turn.
good: A few nods. That's a start.
They're looking at each other now, not the floor.
flat: Polite silence, which is worse than the other kind.
bad: Someone laughs, and it isn't friendly.
You've lost the back of the room.
"Easy for you to say," someone calls out.

results.successLine: They'd follow you out an airlock right now. Try not to need that.
results.failureLine: They're still looking at you, but now it's how they look at a problem.

streetwise.opening: You find a spot where you can watch the door. Somebody here knows what you need to know.
streetwise.help: Choose how you work the room. Everyone wants something different, so watch how they take it.
streetwise.wonLine: Someone slides onto the stool next to you. "I hear you've been asking around."
streetwise.lostLine: The room's gone quiet around you. Time to leave.

approaches.name: Buy a round
approaches.line: Next one's on me. What's the word around here?

approaches.name: Drop a name
approaches.line: A mutual friend said to ask for you.

approaches.name: Slip some credits across
approaches.line: This is for your trouble. There's more if it's good.

approaches.name: Talk shop
approaches.line: Same work, different port. How's business really?

approaches.name: Lean on someone
approaches.line: We can do this friendly, or I can ask your boss.

approaches.name: Say nothing, and listen
approaches.line: You nurse your drink, and let people get used to you.

approaches.name: Show you're no friend of the law
approaches.line: I'm not here for anyone with a badge. Quite the opposite.

approaches.name: Trade a rumor
approaches.line: I'll tell you what I heard, if you tell me what you heard.

strong: Someone laughs and moves over to make room.
"You're all right," they say, and they seem to mean it.
good: They look at you twice. That's progress.
You get a nod, and a name.
The bartender tops you up without asking.
flat: They look through you like glass.
They shrug and go back to their drink.
bad: Conversation dies at the next table.
Someone goes to make a call.
Wrong port for that. You've been noticed.

results.successLine: You've got your answer, and it only cost you a little.
results.failureLine: All you've learned is that people are now asking about you.

deception.opening: They look up from the slate and smile. "Just a few questions."
deception.help: Choose how you answer. Watch how they ask: if they already know the answer, a bold lie will sink you.
questions: Where did you say you were coming from?
How long have you known them?
What was the name of your last port?
What did you do before the Fall?
knowsTells: They glance at their slate before you've even answered.
They ask it a little too casually.
Their eyes don't move from yours. They've asked this before.
They've already started writing something down.
blankTells: They're tired, and checking the time.
They frown at their slate, scrolling for something.
They ask it the way you'd read from a list.
They look away for a moment while you answer.
sold: They nod and write it down. They bought that.
You add one small, perfect detail, and they relax.
caught: "That's interesting. It isn't what it says here."
They let the silence stretch, and tap the slate.
You see the moment they stop believing you.
fine: They accept it, and move on.
It's dull, and dull is good.
They make a small mark, and carry on.
shaky: "You're sure about that?" You're sure. Mostly.
A small frown. Nothing you can do about it now.
dodged: You answer a different question, and they let you.
You make a joke, and it buys you a moment.
deception.blownLine: They set the slate down. "Let's stop pretending, shall we?"
deception.endLine: They close the slate. "I think that's everything."

results.successLine: You keep your face still until you're out of sight.
results.failureLine: It's the kind of smile that means someone's being called.

intimidation.opening: You step in closer than is polite. Now it's just a question of how far to take this.
intimidation.help: Push to raise the pressure. Hold when they're where you want them. Push too far, and they snap.
pushLines: You mention their family, in passing.
You let them see the weapon, without touching it.
holdLines: You stop, and let the silence do the rest.
You straighten up. They flinch anyway.
breakLines: Something behind their eyes gives way. They go for you, or the door, or both.
You've pushed too far. They've stopped being scared, and started being desperate.

results.successLine: They can't look at you. They'll do it.
results.failureLine: All you've done is make an enemy who knows your face.

commerce.opening: They name a figure, and then they name the terms, and smile as if it's a gift.
commerce.help: Make offers, and take the deal when you think it's as good as it'll get.
dealLines: They spit in their palm, and offer it.
acceptLines: They wince, and take it. You're fairly sure the wince is real.
"You're robbing me." They shake your hand anyway.
They look at the ceiling, sigh and nod.
counterLines: "I've got mouths to feed too." They give a little.
They tap the table, and move their price.
insultLines: They laugh, and they don't mean it.
"Is that a joke? Say if it's a joke."
They start putting their things away, slowly.
commerce.walkLine: They stand up. "We're done. Find someone else to insult."

results.successLine: You come out ahead, and they might even deal with you again.
results.failureLine: You'll notice exactly how bad it was around the time it's too late.

awareness.opening: You stop. You don't know why yet. Something's wrong with what you're looking at.
awareness.help: Look for what's different from everything around it, and click it.
foundLines: There. That's what's been bothering you.
Got it. Your neck was right to prickle.
wrongLines: No, that's as it should be.
awareness.allFound: You've got all of it, and now you wish you didn't.
awareness.outOfTime: You can't stand here staring any longer.

results.successLine: You see what nobody else in the room has seen.
results.failureLine: Everything seems fine. That's what you'll remember thinking.

survival.opening: No help is coming, not soon. You take stock of what you've got, and start doing the arithmetic.
survival.help: Each turn, choose what to do. Keep the numbers inside the = marks.

actions.name: Build shelter
actions.line: it isn't pretty, but it holds.

actions.name: Find water
actions.line: it tastes terrible, and it's wonderful.

actions.name: Make a fire
actions.line: it's the best thing you've ever seen.

actions.name: Forage
actions.line: you find something you can eat, probably.

actions.name: Set a proper camp
actions.line: you've done this before, and it shows.

events.text: The temperature falls off a cliff.
You've got nothing left to drink.
A long, punishing stretch of ground.
A storm rolls in.
The heat comes up, and your throat closes.
You turn your ankle.
A bad night. Nobody sleeps.

results.successLine: You've kept yourself going, and you know what to do next.
results.failureLine: You're alive, but your body's sending the bill.

composure.opening: Your heart's going too fast. You've got about a second before it shows on your face.
composure.help: Each turn, choose how you steady yourself. Keep the numbers inside the = marks.

actions.name: Breathe
actions.line: in for four, out for six, the way you were taught.

actions.name: Count the exits
actions.line: two doors, one vent. All right.

actions.name: Bite down on it
actions.line: you say nothing. It costs you.

actions.name: Think of someone
actions.line: you know who you're doing this for.

actions.name: Go completely still
actions.line: you've been in worse rooms than this.

events.text: Someone says your name, very quietly.
They bring up the people you lost.
The pain comes back, all at once.
The lights go out for three long seconds.
You hear them laugh at you.
You remember the last time this happened.
Everyone's watching to see if you'll flinch.

results.successLine: Your hands are steady. Nobody ever has to know what that cost.
results.failureLine: It only shows for a moment, but a moment's all they needed.

attunement.opening: You let the room go quiet, and then the part of you that isn't in the room.
attunement.help: Set the dial, then listen. It's stronger the closer you are. Each listen costs you.
attunement.foundLine: There. It's clear as a bell, and it's looking back.
attunement.spentLine: Your head's splitting. You can't hold this any longer.

results.successLine: You know something now that you've got no way of knowing.
results.failureLine: You come back with a nosebleed, and the feeling you were noticed.

manifestation.opening: You reach for the field. It's always there, and it always wants more than you meant to give.
manifestation.help: Push to draw on it. Hold when you've got enough. Past the limit, it burns you.
pushLines: The air gets thin around you.
The lights dim, and something hums.
holdLines: You hold it, trembling, exactly where you want it.
You stop reaching, and it stays.
breakLines: It goes through you like a bell struck too hard. Everything's white.
You've reached too deep, and it reaches back.

results.successLine: The world does what you asked it to, and it remembers that you asked.
results.failureLine: You've got a bad headache, and everyone nearby has a bad feeling.
